entities.name: Father Stanislaus Lourduswamy
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Stanislaus Lourduswamy, SJ, popularly known as Stan Swamy, was an Indian Catholic Jesuit priest, and a tribal rights activist for several decades. Swamy was the oldest person to be accused of terrorism in India.
